map.输入达人粉丝数、平均互动率与行业单价，估算网红或KOL的合理合作报价区间，用于商: Enter an influencer's follower count, average engagement rate and industry unit price to estimate a reasonable cooperation quote range, as a reference for business negotiation.
map.按粉丝量、互动、平台、内容形式估一条笔记合理报价区间。: Estimate a reasonable quote range for one post from follower count, engagement, platform and content format.
map.对比多个达人 CPM（千粉成本）选高性价比。: Compare CPM (cost per thousand followers) across creators to pick the best value.
map.预算有限时反推能覆盖多少粉丝量级。: With a limited budget, back out how many followers can be reached.
: 50,000 followers (50k), base price per thousand followers 10 CNY, engagement multiplier 1.2, platform factor 1.0, content factor 1.0 -> quote = 50 x 10 x 1.2 x 1 x 1 = 600 CNY, reasonable range 420-780 CNY (±30%).
map.：达人 A 报价 600 触达 5 万（千粉 12 元），达人 B 报价 900: : influencer A quotes 600 CNY reaching 50,000 (12 CNY per thousand followers), influencer B quotes 900 CNY reaching 120,000 (7.5 CNY per thousand); B has a lower unit cost and is better value.
map.报价区间怎么来的？: Where does the quote range come from?
map.以基准报价为中心 ±30% 给出区间，实际受档期、独家、返点影响，区间仅作议价锚: It gives a range of plus or minus 30% around a base quote; actual pricing also depends on schedule, exclusivity and rebates, so the range is only a negotiation anchor.
map.粉丝多就一定贵？: Do more followers always mean a higher price?
map.不一定。互动率低的「僵尸粉」账号千粉成本高、转化差，应看互动加成后的有效报价。: Not necessarily. Accounts with low engagement ("zombie followers") have a high cost per thousand followers and convert poorly, so look at the effective price after the engagement adjustment.
